note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the two scenes are shown side by side without a winner, ranking or conclusion, and nothing states that a rendering is accurate, faithful, certified, sufficient or valid.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative

presets.description: Substantive alternative: different people, languages, words, captions and link kinds (a plain relation between the speakers in A; a communication then a sequence through the interpreter in B); the same single changed fact.
